mcp_tools.name: domain_portfolio_audit
mcp_tools.title: Domain portfolio audit
mcp_tools.description: Submits a domain-portfolio manifest (inventory, brand architecture, declared domain rows, DNS, redirects, email authentication, TLS, renewals, audit) and returns a deterministic DOMAIN_PORTFOLIO_SOUND / DOMAIN_PORTFOLIO_NOT_SOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across four sections, including computed canonical-per-cluster, redirect-graph, email-auth coverage and renewal checks, with per-check evidence. Audits the declared portfolio; it performs no live DNS lookups.

inputSchema.description: The domain-portfolio manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table and domain row schema).

evaluation_date.description: Evaluation date (ISO) renewal checks are computed against.

domains.description: Declared domains: {name, registrar, renewal_date, status, purpose, owner, brand_cluster, is_canonical, is_personal_brand, redirect_target, redirect_status_code, sends_email, spf_declared, dkim_declared, dmarc_declared, spoofing_blocked, registrar_lock, auto_renew}.

expect.notes: Full manifest: one active, non-sending, non-personal-brand domain; renewal 2024-01-01 is 365 days after evaluation 2023-01-01 and outside the 30-day alert window; all 44 checks pass.
